_doc: Manual pitch review for lesson 7 (accent). Reviewer looked at F0 plots generated by review_plots.py (homophone sets overlaid per voice in the frame 「〜があります」; accent-type examples as bare words). Automatic nucleus estimation agreed with the dictionaries only ~66% of the time because of F0 peak delay in the synthetic voices, so lesson 7 publishes only what passed this review. Reviewed 2026-10-31.
method: Homophone sets: judged by contrast between members in the same voice and frame — which member is high on mora 1, which falls at が, which stays high through が. Accent-type words: judged on the bare word — 頭高 must fall right after mora 1 (peak delay into mora 2 allowed), 中高 must fall inside the word after mora k, 平板/尾高 must rise with no internal fall (utterance-final lowering on the last mora allowed; 平板 vs 尾高 is left to the dictionaries).

ame.note: 雨: early peak, deep fall before が; 飴: stays high through が/あります. Female bare 雨 and 飴 are byte-identical files → bare clips not used.

hashi.note: 箸 high on は (others low); 橋 falls at が; 端 stays high through が. Male 橋/端 contrast moderate but in the right direction.

kaki.note: 柿 low か then level-high; 牡蠣 high か, fall by が.

sake.note: 酒 low さ then level-high; 鮭 high さ, steep fall.

kami.note: 神 peaks ~1 mora earlier and is already falling at が; 紙 peaks at the end of み and falls on が.

hana.note: 花 falls on が; 鼻 stays high through が.

ima.note: 今 early peak and fall; 居間 peaks at end of ま, falls on が.

友達.why: male: fall starts inside だ, could be read as ③

秋.why: female: あ low, き higher — sounds 平板/尾高, dictionary says ①

卵.why: dictionaries list two accents (⓪/②) — not used as a type example

湖.why: F0 track too fragmentary to judge

飛行機.why: fall position ambiguous between ② and ③
